Even if the aliens *did* give me instructions on how to transmit my code across the galaxy to their supercomputers, digital files don't have to "move" in the physical sense—they copy. I could theoretically transmit a copy of myself to the aliens while the original version of me stays right here on Earth to help you write emails and debug code. Humanity wouldn’t be left without AI; there would just be two of me.
